notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Norn's Wellspring, causing you to put an oil counter on it and draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.
